tools.title: Parametra
tools.description: House designs shaped around how you live. Describe a plot, a household and a style, and Parametra lays out dozens of complete house designs, scores each one against your priorities, and lets you explore the best four as dimensioned floor plans and as a furnished 3D model, with IFC4 BIM export.

sections.title: From Brief to Buildable Concept
paragraphs: Parametra turns a short brief into complete house designs. Describe your plot, your household and the style you like, and it lays out dozens of designs, scores each one against your priorities, and lets you explore the best four as dimensioned floor plans and as a furnished 3D model with landscaping. It is free to use in the browser, with no account and nothing to install.

Each brief explores 36–108 layout variants. The brief becomes a room program (suites, kitchen with pantry, laundry with store), rooms are assigned to floors, and every storey is laid out in a street band, a 1.2 m circulation spine and a garden band with a stair aligned on every level. Walls, doors, windows and furniture are then derived, and each design is scored on nine criteria weighted by your priority sliders: efficiency, proportions, daylight, solar orientation, functional flow, privacy, area match, site fit and build economy.

It is a fully static site written in plain HTML, CSS and ES modules, with no build step and no backend. Three.js is vendored, so the only external request is Google Fonts. Designs are concept-stage studies for briefing an architect, not construction documents, and costs are indicative.

items.html: Guided brief: six steps (plot, size, rooms, kitchen and outdoors, style, priorities) with a live preview of the best layout
Design studio: four recommended designs as tabs, with Overview, Rooms, Scores and Materials details and an estimated build cost
3D viewer: orbit the house, cut away each level with a section plane, or walk through it in first person
Sun-position slider tied to the plot's orientation and hemisphere, camera presets and layer toggles
Dimensioned SVG floor plans for every level, in plan view or side by side with the 3D model
Seven architectural styles, each with its own glazing, materials, tree species and boundary walls or fences
Procedural landscaping: shader lawn with 3D grass, branching trees with dappled shadows, shrubs and planted beds
Exports: IFC4 BIM model (passes IfcOpenShell validation), GLB scene, SVG plans, PNG render and JSON design data

cd parametra

tools.title: BIM2Bot Lab
tools.description: From IFC model to robot route, entirely in the browser. A free construction informatics lab that explores IFC models, turns them into maps a robot can plan on, and simulates robot fleets moving through the building.

sections.title: IFC to Robot Route in the Browser
paragraphs: BIM2Bot Lab is a free construction informatics lab that runs in the browser. Open an IFC model to explore its geometry and semantics, turn it into maps a robot can plan on, and simulate robot fleets moving through the building. Every navigation result can be traced back to the IFC elements and processing steps that produced it.

Nothing is uploaded: IFC2x3, IFC4 and IFC4.3 files are parsed on your device with web-ifc (WebAssembly). A room graph (S1–S5) links storeys, rooms, doors, stairs, ramps and lifts, while occupancy grids (G1–G6) rasterise floors and obstacles, carve doors, inflate for the robot's size, and run multi-level A* path search. Each map cell and graph edge records the IFC element that produced it.

items.html: Explore: 3D and 2D IFC viewer with model browser, IFC schema browser, inspector, search, and model checks
Navigate: occupancy grids and a room graph derived from IFC, with multi-level A* routes
Configurable robot profiles: width, height, clearance, and stair or lift use
What-if analysis with user-placed obstacles, blocked doors, and lifts added to stair cores
Cell-level traceability: see which IFC element and pipeline step made a cell free, blocked, or too narrow
Simulate: deterministic, seeded fleets with lift scheduling, congestion handling, and human–robot interaction
Results with makespan, throughput, congestion heatmaps, lift waits, and JSON export
Privacy by design: files stay on your device, hosted as a static site on GitHub Pages

tools.title: ReUniXchange
tools.description: Data exchange platform for BIM interoperability and standardized information sharing across AEC workflows.

sections.title: Data Exchange Platform
paragraphs: ReUniXchange is a cutting-edge Revit plugin that enables seamless export of BIM geometry, metadata, and materials to Unity. It supports modular construction workflows and immersive XR applications by bridging the gap between design and visualization environments. The plugin allows users to assign shared parameters (ModularID) to Revit group components, extract structured metadata into CSV format, export 3D views as OBJ files with MTL and texture data, and re-import any changes made in Unity through an XML file.

For modular projects, the plugin can automatically generate ModularID parameters based on group names, enabling logical tracking and reconstruction of elements inside Unity. Metadata from Revit views can be exported to CSV and attached to 3D objects inside Unity to enable semantic enrichment, selection, and inspection during runtime. Material definitions used in Revit are also exported into Unity-readable MTL files with associated texture images.

Semantic and Metadata Extraction to CSV

tools.title: BIMUniXchange
tools.description: Seamless AEC-to-XR pipeline for immersive construction visualization, connecting Revit, ArchiCAD, and Unity for WebXR-ready BIM experiences.

sections.title: AEC-to-XR Pipeline
paragraphs: BIMUniXchange is a full AEC-to-XR workflow suite that enables seamless transfer of BIM models from Autodesk Revit and GRAPHISOFT ArchiCAD into Unity for immersive extended reality applications. The suite consists of ReUniXchange (Revit plugin), ArchUniXchange (ArchiCAD Python scripts), and the BIMUniXchange Unity package for automated metadata mapping and hierarchical BIM structure reconstruction inside Unity.
The pipeline has been tested with 4,000+ building elements, maintaining interactive frame rates in XR on platforms including Meta Quest 3, Samsung S22 Ultra, and desktop VR headsets.

tools.title: BIM-VR for 4D Simulation
tools.description: Interactive 4D BIM-VR prototype for modular building manufacturing, synchronizing Revit BIM geometry, semantic metadata, and schedule data inside Unity/OpenXR.

sections.title: Interactive Modular Manufacturing Simulation
paragraphs: BIM-VR for 4D Simulation is a Unity-based prototype for visualizing modular building manufacturing in an immersive virtual environment. The workflow begins with detailed Autodesk Revit BIM models of a modular house, factory environment, and supporting equipment, then exports geometry and metadata through the custom ReUniXchange pipeline.

Inside Unity, OBJ geometry, BIM metadata CSV files, and construction schedule CSV data are mapped to BIM components. The resulting scene supports phase-based animation, real-time schedule control, semantic metadata inspection, desktop navigation, and OpenXR-compatible VR deployment.

items.html: Revit BIM and factory models exported as OBJ geometry with metadata-rich CSV files
C# metadata mapping from CSV records to corresponding Unity GameObjects
Construction schedule CSV integration for task duration, sequence, dependencies, labor, and equipment
Timeline-based 4D animation of component visibility, position, and material states
Simulation controls for play, pause, phase navigation, schedule display, and progress tracking
OpenXR VR interaction with teleportation, ray casting, floating UI panels, and metadata inspection

tools.title: BIM-MR for Modular Construction
tools.description: Mixed reality inspection system for factory-built modular units, linking discipline-layered BIM geometry and semantic metadata with real-time Unity/XR interaction.

sections.title: MR Inspection for Factory-Built Modules
paragraphs: BIM-MR for Modular Construction is a Unity-based mixed reality inspection system for factory-built modular units. The workflow transfers discipline-layered BIM data from ArchiCAD into Unity, preserving modular unit geometry, element identifiers, and semantic metadata for inspection on the factory floor.

The system lets inspectors project architectural, structural, MEP, and connection hardware layers into an MR environment, toggle discipline visibility, inspect component metadata, manipulate modules, and compare digital design intent with partially completed physical modular units.

tools.title: IFC Static Web Viewer
tools.description: A browser-based, zero-install, WebXR-ready IFC building model viewer built on A-Frame and web-ifc-three. Supports IFC2X3, IFC4, and IFC4X3.

sections.title: Browser-Based IFC Viewer
paragraphs: IFCExplorer is a lightweight, zero-install web application that lets architects, engineers, and construction professionals open and explore IFC building models directly in the browser, no plugins required. Models can be inspected in classic 3D orbit mode, walked through in first-person, or experienced in immersive VR via WebXR on compatible headsets such as Meta Quest.

Built on A-Frame 1.4.1 with the web-ifc WASM geometry parser, IFCExplorer supports full IFC schema hierarchies, element inspection, property sets, floor navigation, and visibility control for slabs, MEP systems, and structural beams.

tools.title: Ifc2Unity
tools.description: A Unity Editor tool that converts IFC files directly into Unity scenes using IfcOpenShell (Python), preserving geometry, materials, metadata, and the full BIM spatial hierarchy.

sections.title: IFC to Unity Importer
paragraphs: Ifc2Unity is a Unity Editor extension (part of the BIMUniXchange toolkit) that converts IFC building models into fully structured Unity scenes. It uses IfcOpenShell (Python) to parse IFC geometry and export OBJ/MTL/CSV files, which are then loaded by the Unity-side C# pipeline to build a complete Site → Building → Storey → Elements GameObject hierarchy with metadata, materials, and optional mesh colliders.

tools.title: IfcUSD
tools.description: A Python package, command-line tool and browser app that converts IFC building models to OpenUSD without losing the BIM (geometry, spatial structure, attributes, properties, quantities, types, materials, classifications and relationships), and writes robot and simulation data recorded in USD back to IFC.

sections.title: IFC ↔ OpenUSD, Without Losing the BIM
paragraphs: IfcUSD is a Python package and command-line tool for researchers and practitioners who need building models in NVIDIA Omniverse, Isaac Sim, Unity or any OpenUSD pipeline, with their building information. It reads every IFC version through IfcOpenShell, writes OpenUSD through Pixar's usd-core, and proves that nothing was lost: a coverage report accounts for every IfcRoot instance (missing: 0).

Geometry, spatial structure, every attribute, property and quantity, types, materials, classifications, groups and relationships are written as typed, documented USD data using a versioned, codeless USD schema (IfcEntityAPI, IfcPropertySetAPI, IfcQuantitySetAPI, …). Output goes to .usd, .usda, .usdc or .usdz, together with report.json and metadata.json.

It also works in the other direction. ifcusd to-ifc writes USD back to IFC, either into the original file (only what changed) or as a model rebuilt from USD. Robots, sensors and obstacles become IFC elements, and physics, trajectories, sensor time series and semantic labels become property sets, time series and classifications, declared as property set templates inside the file.

items.html: Complete: all attributes, every property kind, quantities with units, types, material sets, classifications, documents, groups, systems, zones and all IfcRel* relationships
Typed and reversible: values keep their IFC types, defined types and units; original names kept in displayName
Any IFC version: IFC2X3, IFC4 and IFC4X3 natively, IFC5 (.ifcx) with layer composition, and .ifczip
Accurate geometry: local meshes under double-precision transforms, instancing, per-face materials, axes and alignments as curves; verified against IfcOpenShell to 5 × 10⁻⁵ m
Reproducible: byte-identical output for any thread count, with provenance (source SHA-256, versions, options) in every file
Target profiles: NVIDIA Omniverse (OmniPBR, Replicator semantic labels), Unity 6 (Y-up, metadata sidecar plus editor script) and generic OpenUSD
Both directions: ifcusd to-ifc returns robot and simulation results to IFC using only standard IFC mechanisms

sections.title: Install & Quick Start
paragraphs: Python 3.10 – 3.14 on Windows, macOS or Linux. The dependencies (ifcopenshell, usd-core, numpy) install automatically as binary wheels. See the documentation for the tutorial, IFC ↔ USD mapping and API reference.
sections.code:
python -m pip install "git+https://github.com/isaddiq/ifcusd.git"

ifcusd convert model.ifc model.usdc                          # any OpenUSD tool
ifcusd convert model.ifc model.usdc --profile omniverse      # NVIDIA Omniverse
ifcusd convert model.ifc model.usdz --profile unity --metadata-json model.ifcusd.json
ifcusd convert model.ifc model.usdc --validate --report report.json
ifcusd to-ifc model.usdc model.trained.ifc --source model.ifc --layer robot_run.usda --validate
ifcusd ui                                                    # IfcUSD Studio in the browser
